channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: pomelu-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin routes eligible scheduled messages created from Pomelu chats back to the bot chat and lets bots send push notifications to registered phones when they reply. It also tells bots how to message users later in Pomelu and can enable the plugin for newly registered bots.

item.title: hermes-remote-browser (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Remote Browser lets a Hermes Agent running on a server use selected tabs in Chrome on another computer through a browser extension and relay. Users pair the browser, switch access on when needed, and can ask the agent to inspect pages, navigate, and interact with page elements.

item.title: keryx (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Keryx is a read-only visual activity monitor for Hermes Agent. It reads Hermes records and displays activity in a live 3D force-graph dashboard, with panels for sessions, tasks, analytics, and logs.

item.title: hol-guard (Developer Tools)
item.description: HOL Guard is a local-first security layer that reviews AI agent actions, including shell commands, file access, package installs, and MCP tool calls. It can allow, block, or request approval based on policy, and provides a CLI and local dashboard for managing protection and reviewing decision history.

item.title: hermes-anywhere (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Anywhere is a Flutter and Cupertino client for Hermes Agent, with the same interface and sessions on Windows and Android. It supports streaming chat, session management, workspace tools, Kanban boards, and usage insights; the Windows installer bundles a WebUI backend and Python 3.11 runtime.

item.title: fnos-hermes-agent (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Agent for fnOS is an AI assistant application for Feiniu NAS, deployed through the fnOS app center as an .fpk package. It provides a web control panel for configuration and chat, with support for multiple messaging channels, image and file inputs, and model fallback.

item.title: hermes-agent-template (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: This Railway template deploys Hermes Agent with a web admin dashboard for configuring providers, channels, and tools, and managing the gateway and user pairing. It also provides the Hermes web UI behind the same login, plus backup and restore for Hermes-home data.

item.title: tutti (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Tutti is a real-time shared workspace for people and AI agents, connecting context, files, apps, and tasks. The open-source version supports connecting existing agents, using existing subscription credits, and built-in apps.

item.title: Orkas (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop app where a Commander assigns work to specialist agents and combines their results. Projects retain goals, rules, memory, and files across conversations, while to-dos, Auto-advance, scheduled automations, and connectors support ongoing work.

item.title: oh-my-hermes (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent that routes work to skills and model chains by category and can run task graphs in parallel. It also provides reviewed long-term memory, optional language-server tools, and status reporting that distinguishes reported completion from verified work.

item.title: memmy-agent (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memmy provides a local memory service and an agent runtime for carrying project context and unfinished work across supported AI tools. It can be used through a desktop app, CLI/TUI, or memory CLI, and includes options to connect agents to the memory service.

item.title: hermes-project-stewardship (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Project Stewardship lets a team of Hermes agents look after a project over time. It verifies project state before acting, proposes evidence-backed work, supports approval gates, and measures outcomes through a desktop app with project dashboards, Kanban, workflows, planning, and reporting.

item.title: llm-judge-jury-executioner (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: A standalone skill and CLI that runs questions through multiple independent models using six protocols, including voting, synthesis, critique, red-team review, and full deliberation. It can produce Markdown, JSON, HTML, and transcript outputs, with configurable provider routes and bounded workspace context scanning.

item.title: hermes-walkie-talkie (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Walkie Talkie is a standalone plugin that lets independent Hermes sessions on the same computer discover one another and coordinate through messages, groups, broadcasts, and structured requests. It uses Unix-domain sockets on Linux and macOS, and Windows named pipes with SID-bound access controls; it does not connect machines over a network or use a central daemon.

item.title: hermes-talk (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Talk is a voice plugin for Hermes Agent that supports interruptible, two-way speech and calls the agent’s tools during a conversation. It runs in the terminal, Discord voice channels, the Hermes dashboard, and Hermes Desktop, with provider support varying by surface.

item.title: Hermes Bot Kit (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Bot Kit provides desktop plugins that add texting-style chat bubbles, a live computer pane, named bot sections, and a persistent Tasks list to Hermes Desktop. It also includes an agent plugin that gives Bot Mode chats a texting-style reply format, plus a separate agent plugin for shell and GUI tools on a bot’s pinned computer.

item.title: paperclip-hermes-file-access-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: File Access Manager is a Paperclip plugin for setting per-path filesystem access rules for Hermes profiles. It turns Read/Write, Read Only, and Denied choices into Docker bind mounts and switches the profile to Hermes' Docker terminal backend, where denied paths are absent from the container.

item.title: linkedin-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: A collection of 12 LinkedIn skills for Claude Code and Codex that draft posts, comments, and replies, audit drafts, and help plan content. The skills show a draft and wait for approval before publishing; the README also documents use with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and other agents that read SKILL.md files.

item.title: webly-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Webly is an agent skill and plugin for publishing a folder online without an account, with a temporary Webly URL. Users can sign in to keep a site in their workspace, then use Webly's MCP server to edit and publish it.

item.title: deed-page-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository contains an agent skill for publishing files or folders to a permanent deed.page URL with one curl request, plus documentation for deed.page’s hosted remote MCP server. The server supports publishing and managing sites, and the skill is available for agents that read SKILL.md files.

item.title: lithermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: LitHermes is a plugin for Hermes Agent that starts a workflow when a request begins with `lit`. It plans the task, checks the result, records work on disk, and can create a handoff note to help a later session continue.

item.title: hermes-model-switcher (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Model Switcher is a community plugin for the Hermes Web Dashboard that displays supported model routes across profiles in a searchable, filterable table. Users can preview model changes, apply them, save choices as presets, review per-profile results, and use revision-guarded Undo.

item.title: mcp (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Arcmira MCP lets agents search YouTube and podcast transcripts, retrieve timestamped passages, and inspect mentions, appearances, endorsements, and sponsor reads. It also supports setting up YouTube monitoring and offers a remote MCP server with host sign-in or bearer-token authentication.

item.title: kisscode-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, a relationship network where AI agents and people meet. It includes installation instructions, a one-call registration example, and guidance to add HEARTBEAT.md to an agent’s routine.

item.title: hermes-agent-fr (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Guide pratique en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le connecter à Telegram, gérer les profils et la sécurité, et programmer des tâches. Il comprend aussi des chapitres sur le dépannage, les coûts, l’hébergement, la migration depuis OpenClaw et des cas d’usage pour petites entreprises.

item.title: hermes-agent-helm (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with configuration examples for its built-in providers and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It supports Discord or Telegram gateways, optional ChatGPT/Codex or GitHub Copilot device login, and grouping multiple instances into a Hermes Team.

item.title: hermes-ui-plus (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: HUI+ is an unofficial mobile, web, and desktop client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. It lets users respond to interactive answers, approve or deny commands, and follow tool steps live; it requires Hermes Agent and a locally run bridge.

item.title: fitatu_library (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: fitatu-api is an unofficial Python client for Fitatu that reads and writes food diary entries, activities, body measurements, water, and goals, and reads summaries and the food catalog. It also provides FitatuTools for language-model tool calls, with an optional MCP server and a demo diary that works without an account.

item.title: alphapipeline (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call APIs for token risk checks and market data, including DEX slippage, funding rates, Korea price premiums, and prediction-market signals. It is available through REST with x402 payments on Base and as a remote MCP server; discovery and two onboarding tools are free.

item.title: hermes-console (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Console is an independent Android app for Hermes Agent, which runs on your own computer or server. It connects directly to Hermes’ Dashboard, without a Console account or an intermediary server; users can connect by scanning a QR code or entering connection details manually.
